key: The angry Bouffalant attacked!
en: The angry Bouffalant attacked!
ja: 怒ったバッフロンが攻撃してきた!

key: Tauros roars triumphantly!
en: Tauros roars triumphantly!
ja: ケンタロスが勝ち誇るようにほえた!

key: Tauros seems thankful and compliant.
en: Tauros seems thankful and compliant.
ja: ケンタロスは、感謝して素直になっているようだ。

key: Do you want to try and ride the Tauros?
en: Do you want to try and ride the Tauros?
ja: ケンタロスに乗ってみますか?

key: The angry Tauros attacked!
en: The angry Tauros attacked!
ja: 怒ったケンタロスが攻撃してきた!

key: Bouffalant roars triumphantly!
en: Bouffalant roars triumphantly!
ja: バッフロンが勝ち誇るようにほえた!

key: ...Bouffalant charged blindly away!
en: ...Bouffalant charged blindly away!
ja: ……バッフロンはやみくもに突進して去っていった!

key: ...It sounds like Bouffalant crashed into something!
en: ...It sounds like Bouffalant crashed into something!
ja: ……バッフロンが何かにぶつかった音がした!

key: Ah, and here we have the wild Trainer in their natural habitat...
en: Ah, and here we have the wild Trainer in their natural habitat...
ja: ああ、ここにいるのが、野生のトレーナー、自然の生息地での姿だ……

key: See closely how they strike!
en: See closely how they strike!
ja: よく見るがいい、彼らの攻撃の様子を!

key: Ah, croikey!
en: Ah, croikey!
ja: スティーブ: ああ、こりゃたまげた!

key: Having won another hard-fought battle, the wild Trainer slowly slinks back to their den, leaving the ranger to sulk in peace...
en: Having won another hard-fought battle, the wild Trainer slowly slinks back to their den, leaving the ranger to sulk in peace...
ja: 激闘の末に勝利を収め、野生のトレーナーはゆっくりと巣穴へと戻っていく。レンジャーは静かにすねたまま残される……

key: FERN: Thought I heard a bug or something crawling around over here.
en: FERN: Thought I heard a bug or something crawling around over here.
ja: ファーン: 何か虫みたいなのがはい回ってる音がすると思ったら。

key: Guess I was right.
en: Guess I was right.
ja: やっぱり当たりだったな。

key: Sup.
en: Sup.
ja: よお。

key: Come up here for the Gym?
en: Come up here for the Gym?
ja: ジムのために、ここまで来たのか?

key: There's a huge castle to the east, serves as one.
en: There's a huge castle to the east, serves as one.
ja: 東にでかい城があって、それがジムになってる。

key: I'm up to eight Badges now-- easy and peasy.
en: I'm up to eight Badges now-- easy and peasy.
ja: オレはもう8個バッジ持ってる――余裕だったぜ。

key: Hah, you're only at seven?
en: Hah, you're only at seven?
ja: はっ、お前まだ7個かよ?

key: Falling behind already.
en: Falling behind already.
ja: もう遅れてるじゃねえか。

key: And to think you started before me.
en: And to think you started before me.
ja: オレより先に始めたはずなのにな。

key: Think I'm wrong?
en: Think I'm wrong?
ja: 間違ってると思うか?

key: Just try me!
en: Just try me!
ja: かかってこいよ!

key: Try not being cheap for a change.
en: Try not being cheap for a change.
ja: たまには　せこい手を使わずに戦ってみろよ

key: FERN: Whatever. Not like it matters.
en: FERN: Whatever. Not like it matters.
ja: ファーン: まあいいさ。どうでもいいけどな。

key: I think we all know who the real top dog is anyway.
en: I think we all know who the real top dog is anyway.
ja: どうせ、本当のトップが誰か、みんなわかってるだろうし。

key: Anyway, the way to Carnelia's blocked off for some dumb reason.
en: Anyway, the way to Carnelia's blocked off for some dumb reason.
ja: てか、カーネリアへの道、しょーもない理由で封鎖されてるぞ。

key: The guards decided to take a nap on the job or something.
en: The guards decided to take a nap on the job or something.
ja: 警備の奴らが仕事中に居眠りでも決め込んだみたいだな。

key: Real great work there.
en: Real great work there.
ja: 大した仕事っぷりだよ。

key: So I'm gonna go track down that Normal Leader.
en: So I'm gonna go track down that Normal Leader.
ja: それで、オレはあのノーマルタイプのリーダーを探しに行くとこだ。

key: Some dumb kid--
en: Some dumb kid--
ja: どっかのバカなガキで――

key: I guess he ran away from his place in Lapis?
en: I guess he ran away from his place in Lapis?
ja: ラピスの自分の持ち場から逃げ出したらしいぜ?

key: Seriously, is everyone else around here just committed to fucking up whatever their job is?
en: Seriously, is everyone else around here just committed to fucking up whatever their job is?
ja: マジで、この辺の奴らって、みんな仕事をぶち壊すことに命かけてんのか?

key: I guess that'd explain you.
en: I guess that'd explain you.
ja: まあ、それでお前のことも説明つくけどな。

key: Good luck getting anywhere besides that stupid castle Gym!
en: Good luck getting anywhere besides that stupid castle Gym!
ja: あのバカな城のジム以外、どこにも行けなくて頑張れよな!

key: Later, loser!
en: Later, loser!
ja: じゃあな、負け犬!

key: Skip Aventurine Woods / Route 1 puzzle on this file?
en: Skip Aventurine Woods / Route 1 puzzle on this file?
ja: このファイルのアベンチュリンの森 / 1番道路のパズルをスキップしますか?

key: Aventurine Woods / Route 1 puzzle completion has been detected from a different save file.
en: Aventurine Woods / Route 1 puzzle completion has been detected from a different save file.
ja: 別のセーブファイルで、アベンチュリンの森 / 1番道路のパズルの完了が検出されました。

key: Lemme show you how a real Trainer does it.
en: Lemme show you how a real Trainer does it.
ja: 本物のトレーナーってやつを見せてやるよ。

key: Hmph... I need to work out my EVs better...
en: Hmph... I need to work out my EVs better...
ja: ブライアン: フン……努力値の調整をもっとしっかりやらないと……

key: Man, how am I gonna beat any Leader like this...
en: Man, how am I gonna beat any Leader like this...
ja: まったく、こんな調子でどうやってリーダーに勝てっていうんだ……

key: I enjoy a nice walk. But I enjoy a nice battle even better!
en: I enjoy a nice walk. But I enjoy a nice battle even better!
ja: のんびり散歩するのも好きだけど。バトルの方がもっと好きなんだ!

key: I regret it not!
en: I regret it not!
ja: ルーファス: 後悔などしていない!

key: On your way now, traveler.
en: On your way now, traveler.
ja: さあ、行きなさい、旅人よ。

key: OMG have you ever seen a Flareon!?!? They're so cute and fluffy and did you know their body temperature goes up to 9000 degrees?! Here, come touch mine!
en: OMG have you ever seen a Flareon!?!? They're so cute and fluffy and did you know their body temperature goes up to 9000 degrees?! Here, come touch mine!
ja: やばっ、ブースターって見たことある?!?! めっちゃ可愛くてふわふわで、しかも体温9000度まで上がるって知ってた?! ほら、うちの子、触ってみて!

key: Aren't they so cute and gifted!?
en: Aren't they so cute and gifted!?
ja: ハーク: 可愛くて才能もあるでしょ?!

key: It's so fluffyyyy! I'm gonna die.
en: It's so fluffyyyy! I'm gonna die.
ja: ふわっふわ~! もう無理、死ぬ。

key: FLAREON: Flaaaareon!
en: FLAREON: Flaaaareon!
ja: ブースター: ブウウウスター!

key: Pet Flareon?
en: Pet Flareon?
ja: ブースターをなでますか?

key: FLAREON: Flaaaare~
en: FLAREON: Flaaaare~
ja: ブースター: ブゥース~

key: It's very fluffy! But your hand burns a little...
en: It's very fluffy! But your hand burns a little...
ja: とてもふわふわしている! でも、少し手が熱い……

key: FLAREON: ... Flare.
en: FLAREON: ... Flare.
ja: ブースター: ……ブー。

key: Flareon dejectedly looks away from you.
en: Flareon dejectedly looks away from you.
ja: ブースターが、がっかりしたように目をそらした。

key: FLAREON: Flare! Flare~!
en: FLAREON: Flare! Flare~!
ja: ブースター: ブー! ブー~!

key: Flareon remembers you!
en: Flareon remembers you!
ja: ブースターはあなたを覚えている!

key: The fluffiness burns your hand but warms your heart.
en: The fluffiness burns your hand but warms your heart.
ja: ふわふわの毛が手を熱くするが、心は温まる。

key: FLAREON: Flaaaare...
en: FLAREON: Flaaaare...
ja: ブースター: ブゥー……

key: Flareon pouts at you.
en: Flareon pouts at you.
ja: ブースターが、すねたようにあなたを見つめる。

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
